reviewNotes: Version 1.26.34 only reorganizes the content picker: published podcasts and sermons now appear in two fixed tabs, and the toolbar entry that used to say "Choose sermon week" is relabeled "Sermons & Podcasts". No new permissions, no microphone behavior change, no new data collection. The Chinese weekly study guide is machine translated and not human reviewed (humanApproval=false); the app discloses this on the guide screen.
